title: fix(state): retain first lease heartbeat loss diagnostics
body:
## What Problem This Solves

State lease failures can report only "lease expired or ownership lost", hiding which heartbeat operation first observed the loss during maintenance.

## User Impact

Operators can distinguish automatic renewal, activation, explicit verification, and explicit renewal failures in the existing error diagnostic. This is diagnostic enablement, not a fix for the underlying lease loss. No configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Retain the first static loss path and already-observed outcome through the existing worker-to-parent error flow. Missing ownership is reported as no current owned, unexpired row, without claiming whether a lease expired, was deleted, or was replaced. Existing error causes and codes remain intact; authority checks, TTLs, retries, and shutdown behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

- The focused worker-module/parent regression failed on unmodified production code at the new loss diagnostics; normal-close and contention controls passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/state/openclaw-state-lease-heartbeat.diagnostics.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 13/13 passed, no unhandled errors. Measured Vitest duration 3.87s; native wrapper wall time 5.26s, using cached compiled subprocess outputs. Assertions use fake time and no real sleeps.
- Independent source review and native autoreview found no remaining actionable issue. Synthetic fixtures only; no live state was used.
- The native changed-file check passed against the frozen base, including production/test typechecks, formatting, changed-file lint, dead-export scans, and structural guards.
- Live deployment and reproduction of the original operational failure are not claimed by this PR. Hosted CI cost will be available when its run exists.
